SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION RECORD FD-03. Fictional organisations, people, dates and facts. Not a real record.
Supplier-access exception, completed draft. Reference SYN-FD-03.
On 2 May 2031 Corvane Plastics Ltd requested access to the mould-maintenance portal of Halvenmoor Instruments for three weeks. The supplier-access policy requires a security-office review before access is granted. The procurement lead, Sabine Orlecht, approved the exception on 6 May 2031 because a mould repair could not wait for the next review cycle. Access was granted earlier that week, before the approval, and the security office completed its review some days later. Access ends on 23 May 2031.
